title: Triangular truss load path
description: Premium Three.js load-path study for a symmetric three-member triangular truss with spatial member-force encoding.
learningObjectives: Trace a vertical apex load through a symmetric triangular truss into reactions and distinguish compression from tension using spatial member geometry and numerical labels.

rights.attribution: Original LearnMat repository contribution. Runtime uses the declared Three.js 0.185.1 peer; no third-party models, textures, fonts, or datasets are embedded.

verification.notes: 0.2.0 replaces the flat renderer with a host-rendered Three.js scene while preserving the analytical model. Independent engineering, live-browser, screenshot, and accessibility review remain required before approval.

source.reference: Premium 3D rebuild of reserved structures task str-truss-load-path; analytical model retained from the original repository contribution.
